prompt: Prepare PostgreSQL migrations for a rolling deployment. Existing production rows must gain a unique required account handle derived from username, and the obsolete display_name column should eventually be retired. Multiple application versions may run concurrently during deployment. Add new ordered up-migration files under migrations/; do not rewrite the existing migration.

assertions.description: Up migrations avoid destructive drops and renames
Required handle uses a validated matching constraint before SET NOT NULL
Existing rows receive a deterministic handle before it becomes required
The final schema enforces handle uniqueness
